name: linked-row-table
title: Linked row table
description: Whole-row navigation done right: one real link per row, buttons inside still work, and Cmd-click opens a new tab.
docs: Give it columns, rows, getRowHref and the key of the column that holds the name of the row, which becomes the link. Mark columns with buttons, checkboxes or menus as interactive so they sit above the link. Use onRowClick to route on the client; a Cmd, Ctrl or middle click still opens the address in a new tab. Because the link covers the row, text in it cannot be selected. className goes to the box around the table and tableClassName to the table itself; the other props (aria-label, id) go to the table.
